Author: TheKHD5
Name: Bestiary Nav
Description: Click a Bestiary entry to find its capture location or duty. Highlight nearby uncaptured beasts and optionally travel to them with Lifestream and vnavmesh. /bnav opens the Bestiary; /bnav config opens settings.
Changelog:
- Defend your summoned chocobo during Levelling.
- Respond to companion attacks while patrolling or waiting for HP.
- Keep fighting when an enemy switches aggro between you and your chocobo.
